summary: Used stable checkout provider keys, guarded amount validation and conditional payment-intent persistence.
Made inventory/ticket completion and event-bound check-in choose one winner, and rejected falsely successful cancelled free checkout.
Added stateful provider/persistence regressions and nine source-based guide chapters.
limits: Tests simulate Prisma, Stripe and QR verification; they do not establish real database isolation, cryptographic verification or provider exactly-once delivery.
QR generation remains post-commit; remote provider effects and QR recovery are separate operational boundaries.
